brief:
Médecins Sans Frontières said Monday that Palestinians' living space in Gaza is continuously shrinking while survival essentials are being destroyed through ongoing violence, restrictions on basic needs, and infrastructure damage, Shehab Wire reported.

The organization described conditions in the enclave as marked by systematic destruction of the foundations required to sustain life. MSF linked military operations, resource deprivation, and deteriorating services to the worsening humanitarian situation facing Gaza's population.
